result.question: How many Cybertrucks did Tesla deliver in each month of the last quarter?
result.answer: The provided SEC filing excerpts do not contain monthly Cybertruck delivery figures for any quarter. Tesla's operational summaries report deliveries on a quarterly basis, not monthly. Cybertruck is not separately broken out in the delivery tables. For Q4 2024, the most recent full quarter in the excerpts, "Other models deliveries" totaled 23,640 units [0001628280-25-018851:ex-99-press-release-p003]. The filings do mention that Cybertruck production was ramping — for example, Tesla stated it produced over 1,000 Cybertrucks in a single week in April 2024 [0000950170-24-046895:ex-99-press-release-p003] and Cybertruck achieved a positive gross margin for the first time in Q3 2024 [0001628280-24-043432:ex-99-press-release-p003] — but no monthly delivery counts are disclosed.
